description: This PHP class 'PsrHttpFactoryHelper' provides utility methods to convert between Symfony HTTP request/response objects and PSR-7 request/response objects using Symfony and Nyholm PSR-7 factories.

classes.name: PsrHttpFactoryHelper
classes.description: A helper class to convert between Symfony HTTP objects and PSR-7 HTTP objects.

methods.name: getPsrHttpFactory
methods.description: Returns a singleton instance of PsrHttpFactory, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: getHttpFoundationFactory
methods.description: Returns a singleton instance of HttpFoundationFactory.

methods.name: createPsr7Request
methods.description: Converts a Symfony Request object to a PSR-7 ServerRequestInterface.

methods.name: createPsr7Response
methods.description: Converts a Symfony Response object to a PSR-7 ResponseInterface.

methods.name: createRequestFromPsr7Request
methods.description: Creates a Symfony Request object from a PSR-7 ServerRequestInterface.

methods.name: createResponseFromPsr7Response
methods.description: Creates a Symfony Response object from a PSR-7 ResponseInterface.
